title: Implement complete checkpoints and review submission evidence

checkpoint.summary: Implemented and verified immutable Working progress checkpoints, atomic submission/replacement final checkpoints with pinned spec/source/ref and separate owner-reported test evidence, plus immutable reviewer decision evidence for the frozen revision distinguishing inspection, reported tests and acceptance. Exposed six opt-in MCP methods, 64-bit checkpoint lookup, and safe reconciliation of old pending review commands without fabricating evidence. Full client suite 333/333 and server 62/62 passed.
